content: We have consolidated dataset with 47 polymorphs from 18 compositions (some compositions maybe had fewer than max 3). Next steps: prepare tabular dataset with advanced feature engineering, test_split 0.2, normalize True, target property formation_energy_per_atom. Output path maybe "dataset". Need to specify output_path base path. Let's set output_path = "ml_dataset". It will create files: training.csv, test.csv, etc.
